versions.content: Notify applications about the changes of enable conditions Description: Interested monitoring application shall be notified when the state of an event assigned enable condition has changed. Rationale: Allow applications to know if the current read event status is a current value and event reports are not blocked by disabled event processing. Use Case: Safety concepts on application level depend on current event states (pass/fail) of certain monitors. The information on the current assigned enabled conditions is essential to evaluate if the current event status processing is disabled and the read event status might not reflect the state that is reported by the monitor. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
